sense: a pattern or picture on something

terms.gloss: a picture or pattern, painted, woven or embroidered
terms.comment: Not only a painting: Cicero counts pictures woven into cloth among the works Verres hunted down (Verr. 2.4.1).

terms.gloss: a weave; the pattern of a weave
terms.register: vōx plērumque poētica: Lucr.; also post-Augustan prose (Plin.)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: texture, tissue; Traupman gives it for the pattern of a woven cloth.

sources: Lewis & Short: pictura · Lewis & Short: textus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 117.
